artworks.title: Drover with Oxen Pulling a Cart
artworks.medium: watercolor over brush and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of oxen being driven through a landscape. The painting depicts three oxen harnessed together, striding across a terrain suggested by the lines and swirls of color beneath them. The oxen are rendered with dynamic strokes. The oxen have a variety of shades, including earthy browns and blues that accentuate the contours of their muscles and features. Above them, a flock of birds is represented by scattered silhouettes against a sky that transitions from beige to blue. The overall palate of the painting uses muted earth tones with hints of blue, integrating the figures of the oxen seamlessly into the landscape.

artworks.title: The Prisoner (Der Gefangene)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person behind bars. The person's facial features are abstract and stylized, with angular shapes. The hair is roughly sketched and the expression is undefined. The person wears a draped garment with bold black lines and white spaces. They hold the bars with both hands. The background is filled with black strokes, creating a textured effect.

artworks.title: Standing Girl on Water and the Other Sitting on the Shore
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two figures, one seated with a bent leg and leaning slightly forward, and the other standing with one arm raised above the head. The figures have simple and stylized facial features and distinct facial shapes. The figure on the left has short hair, while the figure on the right has longer, straight hair. Both figures are nude and set against a background that suggests a natural outdoor setting, possibly grass or foliage, depicted with sketchy, abstract lines. The artwork is a monochromatic sketch with no visible jewelry or objects. The background is simplistic, with dark lines used to imply texture and elements.

artworks.title: Woman Before Window
artworks.description: The image displays intricate shapes and lines forming an abstract figure resembling a distorted human body with exaggerated muscles and fragmented limbs. The composition features bold, curving lines creating a contorted form reminiscent of a person in mid-motion, surrounded by what could be interpreted as window or door frames. The figure is positioned off-center, suggesting familiar human postures, while its structure implies movement or tension within an enclosed space.

artworks.title: Study Revealing Anatomy to Medicine and Art
artworks.medium: wash manner, printed in green, red, blue, violet, yellow, brown, and orange inks
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed at or just within platemark): 51.4 x 35.6 cm (20 1/4 x 14 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew and Pauline Robison
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a group of allegorical figures set within an intricate and symbolic composition. Two winged figures are depicted holding an hourglass and a torch in the top portion. In the center, a figure plays a lyre with two cherubic figures nearby. Below, three figures stand on a platform with one partially unveiling a figure on a slab. The artwork includes an architectural background and additional observing figures. The color palette is muted yet rich.

artworks.title: Two Men in Masquerade Costumes: A Cannon Firing and a Cat Inside a Mousetrap
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of intricate lines forming two humanoid figures in an abstract composition. On the left, a figure is depicted as part human, and part cannon, with wheels in place of hips. On the right, another humanoid shape appears with a geometric structure resembling a wooden chest or cabin for a head, and limbs extending in unnatural angles. The abstract nature of these figures combines mechanical elements with human forms.

artworks.title: Monseigneur Charles de Saint-Albin, Archbishop of Cambrai
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on brown laid paper (originally blue), laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from his upper half to his knees. He is turned slightly to the left, with distinct facial features including prominent cheekbones, a well-defined jawline, and full lips. His dark, wavy hair falls onto his shoulders. He wears detailed clerical attire with a high square collar and ecclesiastical robe patterns. He holds a large book in his left hand and places his right hand on his chest. A cross necklace hangs around his neck. The background includes ornate drapery over a column.

artworks.title: Painting
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in a three-quarter view. She is facing forward with a slight turn of her head to the right. She has delicate facial features and a calm expression. Her hair is styled in an intricate updo with flowers. She wears a draped garment, exposing her shoulders and chest. She holds a painter's palette in her left hand and her right hand rests on her chest. Behind her is a statue of a nude male figure on a pedestal, holding a staff and draped with a cloth. The background shows a softly sketched landscape with foliage and a stream.

artworks.title: Two Singers and a Fiddler in an Interior
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, in red on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two people sitting at a table in discussion, with a third playing the violin behind them. The drawing is rendered in a monochrome style using a red-brown ink. The scene captures a moment of interaction, with one person holding a book and gazing at it while the other appears to be listening, holding a tall goblet. The background shows a rustic interior with bare wooden floors and walls. The presence of the violinist adds a sense of music to the atmosphere. There is attention to textures and patterns in the clothing and wooden surfaces.

artworks.title: Adriaen van Ostade
artworks.artist: Jacob Gole after Adriaen van Ostade
artworks.medium: mezzotint in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with long wavy hair and a wide-brimmed hat. He is wearing a garment with a large lace collar and is positioned to the side with a neutral expression. The background includes a circular frame with text surrounding the portrait and a plain, textured background.

artworks.title: A Monk Leading Horses to Water
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white engraving of a natural scene with a horse, a person, and cliffs. The horse is at the bottom, with vegetation and rocks surrounding it. A person is depicted playing a stringed instrument near a cave or rocky alcove. The cliffs dominate the background, with sparse trees and bushes growing on them. The engraving uses fine lines to show texture on the rocks and vegetation, with a monochrome color palette of black ink on a cream background.

artworks.title: A Monk with a Bagpipe Player
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Helmut H. Rumbler
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky, forested area with two figures. The viewpoint appears slightly elevated, overlooking a clearing within the trees. No clear horizon line is visible, as the composition is filled with vertical elements like trees and rocks. The etching showcases detailed lines and textures defining the figures and natural elements. On the left, a hooded figure with a stick stands on a rocky path among tall trees. A second figure sits against a rock, leaning on a staff and looking contemplative. Further back, a rocky cliffside rises with vegetation. The palette is monochromatic with black ink contrasting the pale background, conveying depth and detail.

artworks.title: Der kleine Isarsteg
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge over a calm body of water, surrounded by foliage and trees. In the distance, a building with a steep roof is visible. The artwork features fine lines and crosshatching, with a monochromatic color scheme of black and white. Figures are near the bridge.

artworks.title: The Piazza of Saint Peter's Seen through an Arch of the Basilica
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor, over graphite and pinholes for guidelines, on medium wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural space with an ornate archway leading to an open plaza. In the distance, there is a tall obelisk surrounded by statues and colonnades. The ceiling is intricately decorated with golden motifs, contrasting with the blue sky seen through the archway. The precise brushstrokes capture the detailed decorations. The color palette includes earthy tones for the architecture, gold for the ceiling, and blue for the sky. Geometric patterns on the floor direct the eye towards the plaza.

artworks.title: Gefängnis für die Schaubühne
artworks.artist: Abel Schlicht possibly after Giuseppe Galli Bibiena
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an architectural scene depicting a complex interior space resembling a grand ancient or classical prison structure. The drawing features multiple stories, expansive arches, stone columns, staircases, and elevated walkways. The play of light and shadow throughout the composition emphasizes the solid and permanent nature of the stonework. The style uses dramatic chiaroscuro to highlight the depth and volume of the architectural elements, evoking a sense of historical grandeur and mystery.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman standing in a side-on position, holding a large bundle of hay on her head with one hand. She wears a historical-style outfit, with a long-sleeved white blouse, a dark fitted vest, a long stripe-patterned skirt, and an apron. She has dark hair, and her gaze is directed downward. The background shows stacks of hay and a dense thicket or hedge of vegetation.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting against a pile of hay or grass. She has a serious expression and light complexion, wearing a headscarf, long-sleeved top with an apron, checkered skirt, and simple shoes. She holds a tool in her right hand. The background features tall grass and part of a wooden cart wheel on the left side.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a long-sleeved dress and apron bending over to handle a bundle of hay in a natural setting. They are wearing a light headscarf and the background includes trees and sun-dappled ground. The person's sleeves are rolled up, and the image has a slightly blurred effect, especially around the head area.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing next to a tree outdoors. She is facing left, slightly angled away from the camera. Her head is turned, with a white headscarf covering her hair. She wears a long dark dress with a light shirt underneath, sleeves rolled up to the elbows. In one hand she holds a bundle of branches, and in the other a long stick or tool. Dense foliage surrounds her, with a wooden structure or fence partially visible beside her. Grass and leaves cover the ground.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.description: The image captures a person walking through a natural setting. They are seen from the back, slightly bent forward, with one leg stepping forward as if in motion. Their head is obscured by a wide, floppy hat. The person wears loose pants, a poncho with fringe, and clogs. They carry a bundle with a wooden crutch and a forked tool on their shoulders. The surroundings include dense bushes and trees, suggesting an outdoor, possibly rural environment with grassy, uneven terrain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Child
artworks.artist: Albert Sands Southworth and Josiah Johnson Hawes
artworks.creditLine: The Joyce and Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a young child who is seated and positioned slightly to the side with their head turned towards the left. The child's facial expression is neutral, and they have light-colored hair that is neatly combed and parted to the side. They are wearing a plaid dress with short sleeves and a square neckline with a white lace trim. One arm is across their chest, resting on the fabric of the dress. There is a delicate pearl earring visible in one ear. The background consists of a blurred, dark textured surface, possibly fabric, creating a neutral backdrop. The photograph is encased in a gold-toned frame that has a spattered pattern of darker spots.

artworks.title: An Elaborate Rococo Setting with the Virgin and Child and Saints Defeating Evil, Heresy, and Profane Love
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash and white heightening on blue prepared laid paper, incised for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a heavenly scene with cherubs and robed figures amongst clouds. The central focus is a majestic female figure standing upon a decorative sphere, holding a branch, surrounded by rays and being attended by several adoring figures, some kneeling, with halos emanating light. The composition includes metallic shadings, baroque decorative elements such as swirls and floral motifs framing the center, and cherubic figures symmetrically placed around the scene. The piece utilizes a monochromatic palette of blues and whites to create a celestial atmosphere, enhancing its mythological and religious undertones.

artworks.title: Program for "Théatres l'Athénée"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatre advertisement. The image features the words "Theatre de L'Athénée" at the top. On the left side, a performer in costume swings from a curtain. At the bottom, a woman in period attire holds a fan. Faces in the audience look up towards the stage.

artworks.title: La Remise à Outils, Château d'Argentelle
artworks.description: The image is taken from a slightly elevated angle, showing a rustic, weathered building with a sloping roof and a prominent brick chimney. The horizon is not visible, being obscured by the structure, trees, and a steep hill on the right. The image, likely a photograph, has a soft-focused quality with a sepia tone, giving it an aged look. Close to us, there is an old cart or plow in the grass, partly covered with wild vegetation. In the background, tall trees with dense foliage stand behind the building. The color palette is predominantly brown and beige.
